Record limitations

  • All claims are attributed to public publisher sources; no behavior was observed.
  • No package was downloaded, installed, hashed or executed, and no account or effective configuration was inspected.
  • The exact 3.15 client does not pin Cursor's hosted backend, model provider, model checkpoint, Router policy or server-side feature flags.
  • Cursor 3.0 and 3.6 sources are dated milestones, not proof that their complete behavior is unchanged in 3.15.
  • Mutable documentation, security and data-use pages are rolling-current only.
  • Cloud Agents are a separate hosted surface and are not collapsed into this foreground IDE record.
  • The METR study failed exact client, mode, model and configuration applicability and is excluded from the generated record.
  • No independent behavior, enforcement, privacy, performance, quality or safety conclusion is supported.
  • The successor was created from reviewed official sources without installing or running the agent; release identity does not transfer unscoped behaviour claims.
  • No independent evidence, score, ranking, recommendation, safety certification or suitability conclusion was added.

Unresolved unknowns

What the admitted sources do not establish

Unknown does not mean absent. It means the accepted publisher sources do not establish the fact for an effective session.

  1. The installed operating system, architecture, package type, package digest and executable identity are unknown.
  2. The exact 3.15 release time, source revision and reproducible package-to-source relationship are unknown.
  3. Whether rolling Agent documentation and server-side features matched a particular 3.15 installation is unknown.
  4. The account, plan, organization policy, feature flags and backend service revision are unknown.
  5. The selected foreground target, repository, workspace, worktree or remote-SSH boundary is unknown.
  6. The selected Agent mode, custom instructions, rules, plugins, extensions and enabled tools are unknown.
  7. The terminal profile, shell, inherited environment, credentials, commands and approval outcomes are unknown.
  8. The run mode, allowlists, sandbox policy, classifier model, classifier policy and per-action decision path are unknown.
  9. The configured MCP servers, tools, transports, credentials, arguments and destinations are unknown.
  10. The selected model, provider, checkpoint, endpoint revision, Router mode and administrator restrictions are unknown.
  11. The effective Privacy Mode, provider ZDR status, data transmitted, retention, training use and abuse-classifier exceptions are unknown.
  12. Task completion, edit quality, rollback, command containment, data handling and safety were not independently tested.
